name: report_compare
title: Compare two runs of a report
description:
Compares two stored runs of a report section by section; nothing is called again.
Returns: report, a and b (run_id, started_at, parameters), same_definition, sections (KPIs with a, b, change and pct_change; table rows added, removed and changed by key column; status changes).
Inputs (* required): report*; run_a* and run_b* (run ids, or dates YYYY-MM-DD for your latest run on that day).
Example: {"report": "desk_calendar", "run_a": "2026-10-09", "run_b": "2026-10-10"}

report.description: Report name (report_list lists them), e.g. desk_calendar

run_a.description: The earlier run: a run id or a date (YYYY-MM-DD)

run_b.description: The later run: a run id or a date (YYYY-MM-DD)

annotations.title: Compare two runs of a report
